ladder_summary: Seven observed rungs for a one-product launch set (KV + 8 stills + 15–20 s film + 3 cutdowns + kit): (1) SELF-SERVE tools R$25–1.000/month (Higgsfield US$49 ≈ R$255; Google AI Pro R$96,99; Photoroom US$7,50–82,50; BR SaaS R$29–2.990) — the whole set costs ≈US$34 of credits. (2) MARKETPLACE gigs: VintePila R$20–100 per gig; Fiverr median 'From' US$15 per AI skincare image gig and US$40 per AI cosmetic video gig; a HERO-equivalent bought on Fiverr ≈US$270–350 ≈ R$1.400–1.800. Buyer budgets on Workana/99Freelas sit at <USD 50–250. (3) AI DONE-FOR-YOU with PUBLISHED prices: ANIMAI R$70/image + R$15/second ⇒ HERO-equivalent ≈R$1.400–2.900; Make Move R$3.000 minimum for an AI shoot (stills only; 1 product = 8 photos). (4) Traditional producer's AI line: Destaquei AI video R$5.000–8.000. (5) AI/hybrid houses that do NOT publish (AiA, Maestria, Composer Invent, Miragem, 511, fotografiastill, Cinematik) — margin lives here, price invisible. (6) LEAN TRADITIONAL build from published components ≈R$9.900–17.000, 15–30 days. (7) AGENCY-LED at Sinapro list ≈R$35.000–42.000 (ceiling).
where_5900_sits: HERO R$5.900 (≈US$1.134) sits at the TOP of the observed AI band and the BOTTOM of traditional: 2,0× Make Move's minimum, 2,0–4,2× ANIMAI's HERO-equivalent, 3,3–4,2× a Fiverr HERO-equivalent, ~23× a month of Higgsfield PLUS — and inside Destaquei's own AI-video range (R$5.000–8.000), ~35–60% of a lean traditional build, ~14–17% of an agency build at Sinapro list. FAMILY R$9.900 (≈US$1.902, R$2.475/product) is weaker: for 4 products Make Move still charges its R$3.000 minimum for stills, and R$9.900 sits INSIDE Destaquei's traditional 1–10-product package range (R$8.000–25.000, incl. photo pack and cuts) — the traditional day amortises across products, so the AI discount narrows as product count rises.
evidence_of_the_middle_band: ASKING prices exist in the R$3.000–8.000 band from three unrelated sellers: Make Move R$3.000–5.000 (AI, with synthetic casting and beauty direction), Destaquei AI video R$5.000–8.000 (stated as the average of its own projects — the closest to clearing found), MonkeyBusiness's lowest budget band R$5.000–10.000. Buyers DO commission AI campaigns from studios (AiA names Triton, Sommer, Easy Lança Perfume, Dimy, Kyly-group brands; Composer Invent names Rennova) — but not one invoice, contract or published clearing price for an AI launch set in R$3–10k was found. Counter-evidence: public bodies buy the self-serve route + training (MPU CapCut Pro R$1.800/yr, Magnific Business R$7.072,30/yr; ANAC paid R$2.580 for two staff on an ESPM 'Produção criativa com IA' course), marketplace buyers budget <USD 50–250 even for 'campanha completa', and Destaquei itself routes budget-constrained buyers to a R$29/month AI tool. Verdict: the band is real on the SELL side and UNPROVEN on the BUY side.
biggest_flaw: R$5.900 has no clearing evidence and every published AI done-for-you price in Brazil for the same scope is 2–4× lower (ANIMAI ≈R$1.400–2.900, Make Move R$3.000, Fiverr ≈R$1.400–1.800); the only seller at R$5–8k is a traditional producer (Destaquei) that already ships AI and also sells the R$29/month escape hatch — so incumbents occupy the bottom, the middle and the top, and the plan's two differentiators (taste, product fidelity) are not visibly priced by anyone. The sale will be benchmarked against Make Move/ANIMAI or the in-house route (Higgsfield US$49 + a marketer), not against a R$10–17k shoot, unless the proposal forces that comparison.
repair: (1) Price against the REPLACED SHOOT, itemised in every proposal with public numbers the buyer can check — model day with 2-year usage R$2.500 (Job for Model), studio R$754–1.200 (Estúdio Bala), photographer from R$1.690 and product video from R$3.500 (Destaquei), HMU, retouch, 15–30 days — against R$5.900 in 7 business days; Sol's modelling background makes this line-by-line comparison credible without her being a 'credentialled expert'. (2) Sell what nobody on the ladder sells in writing: a FIDELITY GUARANTEE (client-approved 'Product Lock'; any label/geometry/colour error redone free, no revision cap on product truth) — the Fiverr review shows fidelity failure is the known pain at the bottom — and PERPETUAL, all-media usage of the synthetic model (human models are licensed for 1–2 years and the agency adds +30% for prolonged rights). (3) Add an entry rung for the first 15 campaigns: 'HERO STILLS' R$2.900–3.500 (KV + 8 stills, Product Lock, no film) priced at Make Move's level, keep HERO at R$5.900 only with film + guarantee + perpetual usage; measure which one clears. (4) Reprice FAMILY to R$11.900–12.900 or reposition it against traditional multi-product packages (R$8–25k), not as a discount. Honest floor if pricing clears at ~R$3.000 and she closes 2–3/month in year one: gross R$6.000–9.000 ⇒ ≈US$950–1.490/month net after ~6% Simples and ~R$700/month tools (R$6.000−360−700 = R$4.940; R$9.000−540−700 = R$7.760); at R$5.900 × 2/month ≈US$2.000 (R$11.800−708−700 = R$10.392). Cheapest next test (R$0, Portuguese calls): 20 calls to haircare/skincare brands that launched in the last 90 days (Beauty Fair 2026 exhibitors), one question — 'quanto custou o pacote visual (fotos + vídeo) do último lançamento, e com quem?' — bar committed in advance: ≥6/20 name ≥R$5.000 for a one-product set keeps HERO at R$5.900; 3–5 ⇒ lead with the R$2.900–3.500 rung; ≤2 ⇒ the middle band does not exist for this buyer and VBPH must sell to agencies (wholesale), not brands.
